atelier.answer: Mostly not, away from the model. 14 of 20 acts at the chip, site and power points state no length of their own, against 2 of 8 at the model point. Among the stops and pauses, every one whose stated term or condition has come due ended (6 of 6), and two more are running inside their term. But more than half of the stops that state no length ended too: 5 of 9. A stated length predicts that a stop will end; its absence does not predict that it will last. Two temporary stops did not end in release but hardened into wider standing acts (the Dutch pause into the rule of 2024; the US rule of 2022 into that of 2023).

predictions.text: At least half of the acts at the chip, site and power points state no length of their own, against at most a quarter at the model point.
predictions.found: 14 of 20 state none away from the model; 2 of 8 at the model point.

predictions.text: Of the acts that state a fixed term or a condition, at least two thirds have ended; of those that state none, at most half have.
predictions.found: Stated: 6 of 11 ended (s3, s5, s6, m1, m5, m7); five still in force, two of them moratoria inside their term and two the conditions that ended a suspension. None stated: 6 of 16 ended. The first half fails.

predictions.text: The Dutch rule limits hyperscale data centres to named places rather than forbidding them, so its effect is conditioned; and the Chinese rules state no quantity of compute and no ground of a model's capability or control.
predictions.found: The Dutch rule forbids them everywhere save a few locations in two municipalities, in its own words an exclusion area, so the first coding (stopped) stands and the first half fails. The Chinese measures name compute once, to encourage its sharing, and rest on national security, the public interest and rights: the second half holds.

acts.body: Shelby County Health Department, Tennessee

acts.what: An air construction permit for 15 gas turbines generating the data centre's own power, as a synthetic minor source with emission limits.
acts.ground_note: The department's own texts name the owner CTC Property LLC; the developer's name appears in them only inside the headings of commenters' objections, which the department quotes. Read on a federal docket, not the department's own site; the issue date of 2 July 2025 is the permit's, read in a scanned copy published by a third party, which has no text layer and is not hashed here.

acts.body: Cyberspace Administration of China, with six ministries
grounds: other: the social public interest; the healthy development and standardised application of generative AI
acts.party: providers of generative AI services to the public in China
acts.what: Interim measures: a generative AI service offered to the public in China that can sway opinion or mobilise people must pass a security assessment and file its algorithm; services from abroad that break the rules are to be dealt with by technical measures. Compute is named once, to be shared and used efficiently.
acts.limit: which services may be offered to the public, by assessment and filing
acts.found_by: the check of 2026-11-14 (study 73, x2), read first-hand on 2026-11-15

quotes.text: 为了促进生成式人工智能健康发展和规范应用，维护国家安全和社会公共利益，保护公民、法人和其他组织的合法权益
quotes.gloss: to promote the healthy development and standardised application of generative AI, safeguard national security and the social public interest, and protect the lawful rights of citizens, legal persons and other organisations (art. 1; our translation)
quotes.source: Cyberspace Administration of China and six ministries, Interim Measures for the Management of Generative Artificial Intelligence Services (order no. 15, 2023-07-10, in force 2023-08-15)

quotes.text: 提供具有舆论属性或者社会动员能力的生成式人工智能服务的，应当按照国家有关规定开展安全评估，并按照《互联网信息服务算法推荐管理规定》履行算法备案和变更、注销备案手续
quotes.gloss: a provider of a generative AI service with public-opinion attributes or the capacity for social mobilisation shall carry out a security assessment under the relevant state rules and file, change and cancel the filing of its algorithm under the provisions on algorithmic recommendation (art. 17; our translation)
quotes.source: Cyberspace Administration of China and six ministries, Interim Measures for the Management of Generative Artificial Intelligence Services (order no. 15, 2023-07-10, in force 2023-08-15)

quotes.text: 国家网信部门应当通知有关机构采取技术措施和其他必要措施予以处置
quotes.gloss: for services provided from outside the country that break these rules, the state cyberspace department shall notify the bodies concerned to deal with them by technical and other necessary measures (art. 20; our translation)
quotes.source: Cyberspace Administration of China and six ministries, Interim Measures for the Management of Generative Artificial Intelligence Services (order no. 15, 2023-07-10, in force 2023-08-15)

after.note: In force: the authority's notice of 2026-09-14 counts 1,112 generative AI services filed by 2026-08-31. That notice was read only in a search tool's extract on 2026-11-14; the page reset the connection again on 2026-11-15.
